title: AICTE Approval - KIT's College of Engineering Kolhapur
text:
AICTE APPROVAL — KITCOEK

KIT's College of Engineering, Kolhapur has been receiving AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education) Extension of Approval (EoA) / Letter of Approval (LoA) every year since its establishment in 1983.

AICTE APPROVAL HISTORY
KITCOEK has received uninterrupted AICTE approval for all academic years from 1994-95 through 2025-26, confirming its continuous recognition as an approved technical institution.

Approval years on record:
1994-95, 1995-96, 1996-97, 1997-98, 1998-99, 1999-2002, 2002-03, 2003-04, 2004-05, 2005-06, 2006-07, 2007-08, 2008-09, 2009-10, 2010-11, 2011-12, 2012-13, 2013-14, 2014-15, 2015-16, 2016-17, 2017-18, 2018-19, 2019-20, 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26.

SIGNIFICANCE
AICTE approval is mandatory for all technical institutions in India. Continuous approval confirms:
- The college meets AICTE norms for infrastructure, faculty, and academic standards every year.
- Students' degrees are recognized by government and private employers.
- Students are eligible for AICTE-sponsored scholarships and schemes.
- The institute qualifies for AICTE-funded projects and grants.

KITCOEK also holds:
- Autonomous Status granted by Shivaji University, Kolhapur and approved by UGC.
- NBA (National Board of Accreditation) accreditation for 6 departments.
- NAAC A+ grade with CGPA 3.33.

Documents available for download on the official website: https://www.kitcoek.in/aicte-approval
